fact: The DGMP-DSP says the SIGMAP procurement management software is operational in five regions and Bamako as phase one of dematerialisation, with online bid submission as phase two still in preparation.
The DGMP-DSP says 74% of contracting authorities have access to SIGMAP and about 1,000 users have been trained.

The Ministry of Economy and Finance officially launched the Sigmap integrated public procurement management system on 4 December 2015; its coordinator said the first phase of design and development is due to finish in 2017.
